transcript: Speaker A: Tuti-futi English se confident English ka safar teen steps mein. Sabse pehle toh aap apne phone mein PW Talk app download kar lo. Number one, basics clear karo. Uske liye PW Talk app par reels jaise chhote-chhote videos hain jinhein Physics Wallah ki team ne banaya hai. Jab bhi free time mile toh reels ki jagah inhein dekho. Bina kisi mehnat ke aapke basics clear ho jayenge. Number do, practice karo dimaag se. Nouns, pronouns ya dictionary ka ratta maarne se kabhi bhi English speaking achhi nahi hone wali. PW Talk app par aapko aisi exercises milengi jo aapko real life mein use hone wali English sikhayengi. Din mein das se pandrah minute hi practice karna kaafi hai. Number teen, bolna shuru karo bina dare. Zyada se zyada English mein baat karna start karo. Lekin doston ke saamne bolne se galti karne ka darr rehta hai. Isliye PW Talk app pe AI teacher ki help le sakte ho jo aapki galtiyon ko judge nahi karengi aur aapko sahi English sikhayengi. Toh basics, exercises aur real speaking ki practice, teeno ek hi app par kar sakte ho. Abhi PW Talk app download kar lo. [Speaker A: The journey from broken English to confident English in three steps. First, download the PW Talk app. Number one, clear your basics with short reels-like videos. Watch these in your free time to easily learn. Number two, practice smartly. Rote learning grammar won't help, but PW Talk's real-life exercises will. Just 10-15 minutes a day is enough. Number three, start speaking without fear. Avoid the fear of judgment from friends by practicing with PW Talk's AI teacher. Get basics, exercises, and speaking practice all in one app. Download PW Talk now.]
